values.name: CYAML_SCALAR_EXPLICIT_EMPTY
values.doc: Empty value that should NOT become null

structs.name: cyaml_span_t
structs.doc: Span - a reference into source data with location info This is the core building block: no string copying during parse

fields.name: chunks
fields.doc: Array of chunk pointers (never moved once allocated)

structs.name: cyaml_stream_t
structs.doc: [9.2] Stream - contains one or more documents l-yaml-stream ::= l-document-prefix* l-any-document? ... Source is always borrowed - caller manages lifetime

functions.name: cyaml_parse
functions.summary: Parse first document from YAML string
functions.return_doc: Document or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_free
functions.summary: Free document and all nodes (does not free source buffer)

functions.name: cyaml_parse_stream
functions.summary: Parse YAML stream containing multiple documents
functions.return_doc: Stream or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_stream_free
functions.summary: Free stream and all documents (does not free source buffer)

functions.name: cyaml_span_dup
functions.summary: Duplicate span as null-terminated string
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL

functions.name: cyaml_scalar_str
functions.summary: Get scalar value as string with all YAML processing applied Handles escape sequences, line folding, and block scalar indent stripping.
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL

functions.name: cyaml_span_eq
functions.summary: Compare span to string (case-sensitive)
functions.return_doc: true if equal

functions.name: cyaml_span_ieq
functions.summary: Compare span to string (case-insensitive)
functions.return_doc: true if equal (ignoring case)

functions.name: cyaml_span_cmp
functions.summary: Compare two spans for equality
functions.return_doc: true if equal

functions.name: cyaml_as_int
functions.summary: Parse scalar as signed integer Supports decimal, hex (0x), and octal (0o) formats.
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_as_uint
functions.summary: Parse scalar as unsigned integer Supports decimal, hex (0x), and octal (0o) formats.
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_as_float
functions.summary: Parse scalar as floating point Supports .inf, -.inf, and .nan special values.
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_as_bool
functions.summary: Parse scalar as boolean Recognizes true/false (case-insensitive).
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_is_null_val
functions.summary: Check if scalar represents null Recognizes ~, null, Null, NULL, or empty value.
functions.return_doc: true if null

functions.name: cyaml_get
functions.summary: Get mapping value by string key
functions.return_doc: Value node or NULL if not found

functions.name: cyaml_has
functions.summary: Check if mapping contains key
functions.return_doc: true if key exists

functions.name: cyaml_path
functions.summary: Navigate to node at YPATH Uses YPATH syntax: /store/books[0]/title, /users/*/name, etc. Absolute paths (starting with /) evaluate from document root.
functions.return_doc: First matching node or NULL if not found

functions.name: cyaml_doc_new
functions.summary: Create empty document for building YAML programmatically
functions.return_doc: New document or NULL on allocation failure

functions.name: cyaml_node_new
functions.summary: Allocate node of specified type from document pool
functions.return_doc: New node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_null
functions.summary: Create null node
functions.return_doc: New null node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_str
functions.summary: Create scalar node from string with explicit length
functions.return_doc: New scalar node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_cstr
functions.summary: Create scalar node from null-terminated string
functions.return_doc: New scalar node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_int
functions.summary: Create scalar node from signed integer
functions.return_doc: New scalar node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_uint
functions.summary: Create scalar node from unsigned integer
functions.return_doc: New scalar node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_float
functions.summary: Create scalar node from floating point
functions.return_doc: New scalar node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_bool
functions.summary: Create scalar node from boolean
functions.return_doc: New scalar node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_seq
functions.summary: Create empty sequence node
functions.return_doc: New sequence node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_new_map
functions.summary: Create empty mapping node
functions.return_doc: New mapping node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_seq_push
functions.summary: Append item to sequence
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_map_set
functions.summary: Set or update mapping key-value pair
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_emit

params.name: opts
params.doc: Emit options (NULL for defaults: 2-space indent, 80 char width)

functions.summary: Emit document to newly allocated YAML string
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_emit_node
functions.summary: Emit single node to newly allocated YAML string
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_stream_emit
functions.summary: Emit stream to YAML preserving original formatting
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_dump
functions.summary: Dump document to canonical YAML format Uses yaml-test-suite out.yaml format conventions.
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_stream_dump
functions.summary: Dump stream to canonical YAML format (all documents)
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_events

params.name: indent
params.doc: Add visual indentation (false for yaml-test-suite format)

functions.summary: Emit event stream for single document
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_stream_events
functions.summary: Emit event stream for full stream (all documents)
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_json
functions.summary: Convert document to JSON
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_stream_json
functions.summary: Convert stream to JSON Single document streams output the JSON value directly. Multi-document streams output as a JSON array.
functions.return_doc: Allocated string (caller must free) or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_set_anchor

params.name: doc
params.doc: Document containing the node (must be in BUILDING mode)

functions.summary: Set anchor name on a node
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_new_alias
functions.summary: Create alias node pointing to an anchored node
functions.return_doc: New alias node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_find_anchor
functions.summary: Find node by anchor name (searches from root)
functions.return_doc: Node with anchor or NULL if not found

functions.name: cyaml_resolve_aliases
functions.summary: Resolve all aliases in document (replace with deep copies of targets)
functions.return_doc: true on success, false if unresolved aliases remain

functions.name: cyaml_node_copy
functions.summary: Deep copy a node into a document Copies node and all children. Scalar content is copied into target doc.
functions.return_doc: New node or NULL on failure

functions.name: cyaml_map_merge
functions.summary: Deep merge src map into dst map For conflicting keys: scalars replaced, maps merged recursively, seqs replaced.
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_map_sort
functions.summary: Sort mapping keys
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_map_sort_recursive
functions.summary: Sort mapping keys recursively (all nested maps)
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_scanf
functions.summary: Extract values using path-based scanf
functions.return_doc: Number of successfully extracted values, -1 on format error

functions.name: cyaml_vscanf
functions.summary: Extract values using path-based scanf (va_list version)
functions.return_doc: Number of successfully extracted values, -1 on format error

functions.name: cyaml_node_scanf

params.name: node
params.doc: Starting node for relative paths (NULL = root)

functions.summary: Extract values starting from a specific node Relative paths start from node, absolute paths (/) still use root.
functions.return_doc: Number of successfully extracted values

functions.name: cyaml_node_vscanf

params.name: node
params.doc: Starting node for relative paths (NULL = root)

functions.summary: Extract values starting from a specific node (va_list version)
functions.return_doc: Number of successfully extracted values

functions.name: cyaml_buildf
functions.summary: Build node from printf-style format string Creates nodes by substituting values into a YAML template. Formats: %d, %u, %ld, %lu, %lld, %llu, %f, %lf, %s, %b
functions.return_doc: New node or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_vbuildf
functions.summary: Build node from printf-style format string (va_list version)
functions.return_doc: New node or NULL on error

functions.name: cyaml_insert_at

params.name: doc
params.doc: Document to modify (must be CYAML_BUILDING mode or parsed)

params.name: val
params.doc: Value node to insert (must be from same doc)

functions.summary: Insert or update node at path Creates intermediate maps as needed. For existing keys, replaces value. Path must resolve to a valid insertion point.
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_insertf
functions.summary: Insert printf-built node at path (convenience) Equivalent to: cyaml_insert_at(doc, path, cyaml_buildf(doc, format, ...))
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_delete_at
functions.summary: Delete node at path Removes the node from its parent container.
functions.return_doc: true if deleted, false if not found

functions.name: cyaml_append_at
functions.summary: Append to sequence at path Path must resolve to a sequence node.
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_appendf

params.name: format
params.doc: YAML format string for new item

functions.summary: Append printf-built node to sequence at path Path must resolve to a sequence node.
functions.return_doc: true on success

functions.name: cyaml_node_cmp_str
functions.summary: Compare scalar node value to string (like strcmp)
functions.return_doc: 0 if equal, <0 if node < str, >0 if node > str

functions.name: cyaml_node_eq_str
functions.summary: Check if scalar node equals string
functions.return_doc: true if node value equals str

functions.name: cyaml_strerror
functions.summary: Get human-readable error message
functions.return_doc: Static error string

functions.name: cyaml_version
functions.summary: Get library version string
functions.return_doc: Static version string (e.g., "0.1.0")

functions.name: cyaml_path_query

params.name: context
params.doc: Context node for relative paths (NULL = use root)

functions.summary: Execute a YPATH query and return all matching nodes Nodes returned are pointers into the document - no data is copied.
functions.return_doc: Result with matched nodes or error info

functions.name: cyaml_path_result_free
functions.summary: Free query result

functions.name: cyaml_path_first

params.name: context
params.doc: Context node for relative paths (NULL = use root)

functions.summary: Get first matching node (convenience wrapper) Equivalent to cyaml_path_query + taking first result + free.
functions.return_doc: First matching node or NULL on error/no match

functions.name: cyaml_path_debug
functions.summary: Debug: dump tokens and parsed AST to stdout

structs.name: cyaml_path_result_t

fields.name: nodes
fields.doc: Array of pointers to matched nodes (owned by doc)

fields.name: error_pos
fields.doc: Position in path where error occurred

structs.doc: Query result containing matched nodes or error info
